source: We made several memory and performance improvements. Raycast's host process now uses about 50% less memory. Each extension process uses about 30% less memory at startup and less CPU when launching, which helps menu bar commands, background refreshes, and AI tools. We also fixed a memory leak that grew the longer Raycast stayed open. More details are below, and further improvements are coming in the next updates.
previous: 我们对内存占用和性能进行了多项改进。Raycast 主进程的内存占用现已降低约 50%；每个插件进程启动时的内存占用降低约 30%，启动时的 CPU 占用也有所减少，这有助于改善菜单栏命令、后台刷新和 AI 工具的表现。我们还修复了一个会随 Raycast 运行时间增长而加剧的内存泄漏问题。更多详情见下文，后续更新还将继续优化。

source: We reworked our Auto model, and you can now choose how it picks a model for you. It comes with three different preferences: Lightweight, Balanced, and Flagship. Balanced is the default and uses about 70% fewer credits than Flagship to help you get more out of your credits. Lightweight responds in about 70% less time than Flagship and works well for quick questions. Flagship uses the most capable models for harder tasks and requires a Pro+ or Max subscription.

![image](https://misc-assets.raycast.com/releases/8180fca8af2a3dd485321a4b2ffbcf08b4351060083a24309b72382035035638.png)


We made several memory and performance improvements. Raycast's host process now uses about 50% less memory. Each extension process uses about 30% less memory at startup and less CPU when launching, which helps menu bar commands, background refreshes, and AI tools. We also fixed a memory leak that grew the longer Raycast stayed open. More details are below, and further improvements are coming in the next updates.


## 🤖 Auto Model


We reworked our Auto model, and you can now choose how it picks a model for you. It comes with three different preferences: Lightweight, Balanced, and Flagship. Balanced is the default and uses about 70% fewer credits than Flagship to help you get more out of your credits. Lightweight responds in about 70% less time than Flagship and works well for quick questions. Flagship uses the most capable models for harder tasks and requires a Pro+ or Max subscription.


## ✨ New

- **AI:** Added Claude and ChatGPT subscription usage in `/usage` in AI Chat and in Settings
- **AI:** Added Show AI Credits/Claude/ChatGPT Usage commands
- **Clipboard History**: Added a Paste as PNG action for TIFF images
- **Root Search**: Added direct search results for more settings, including Accessibility settings and Keyboard Shortcuts
- **UI**: Added automatic color contrast adjustments throughout to ensure the UI remains legible

## 💎 Improvements

- **AI Chat**: Mermaid diagrams now load only when a chat first needs them, which reduces memory usage
- **AI Permissions:** Extended Always Allow approvals to cover similar commands
- **AI Permissions:** Reduced approval interruptions for routine Git and GitHub workflows, and improved Auto approval decisions
- **Calendar**: Command icons now display the current date across Raycast
- **Calendar**: Renamed the menu bar setting "Only show events with meetings" to "Only show events with a conference link", so it's clear why events without a video call link are hidden
- **Clipboard History**: Improved contrast of color swatch in color items
- **Eject All Disks**: Improved support for external drives and disk images, and added details about disks that could not be ejected
- **Extensions**: Clarified how uninstalling an extension affects its settings and data across synced devices
- **Extensions**: Improved performance when extensions refresh frequently in the background
- **File Search**: The file indexer uses about 60% less memory when it updates its index
- **General**: Improved reliability when your Mac wakes from sleep
- **Memory Usage**: Reduced idle memory use and improved memory cleanup after closing Raycast windows by releasing retained graphics memory
- **Memory Usage**: Reduced memory overhead from command icons
- **Memory Usage**: Reduced extension worker memory by ~30% in idle workers
- **Memory Usage**: Reduced native host memory by 50%
- **Memory Usage**: Improved process memory diagnostic
- **Performance:** Reduced extensions worker startup CPU usage
- **Performance:** Speed up command launches and prevent misinput while commands are loading
- **Quick AI**: Added an option to hide the Quick AI hint in Root Search
- **Root Search**: Recent searches keep their results, so typing them again responds faster
- **Root Search**: Added support for numpad for number hotkeys

## 🐞 Fixes

- **Action Panel:** Fixed loading spinner alignment in search menus
- **AI**: Fixed new chats sometimes using the incorrect model when using the “Last Used Model” default setting
- **AI:** Fixed an issue where Codex CLI wouldn’t be located properly after recent ChatGPT update
- **AI Chat:** Fixed an issue where pinning a chat removed it from its project
- **AI Chat:** Improved sidebar spacing and chat title fading
- **AI Chat**: Fixed "Open AI Settings" opening an empty Settings window instead of the AI settings
- **Clipboard History**: Fixed missing text previews and link detection for URLs received through Universal Clipboard
- **Commands**: Fixed losing keystrokes when typing immediately after launching a command with a hotkey
- **Commands**: Fixed invisible Raycast windows blocking clicks in other apps after commands that did not open a window
- **Dictation**: Fixed function-key shortcuts failing when `Fn` was held to press the function key (`F1` , `F2`...)
- **Emoji Picker**: Ensured AI results are stable when pasting & keeping the window open
- **Extensions**: Fixed AppPicker width something blowing up
- **Extensions**: Fixed colored tags/icons being illegible in some cases
- **File Search**: Fixed a memory leak when reading text from images
- File Search: Fixed recent files disappearing while the file index updates
- **Keyboard**: Fixed a crash that could occur when changing keyboard input sources
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Fixed recorded shortcuts changing to modifier-only shortcuts when releasing the keys
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Fixed double-tap shortcuts losing their left or right modifier selection when recorded
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Fixed hotkeys failing to trigger when assigned to left or right modifier keys, or when Caps Lock was enabled
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Fixed modifier hotkeys unexpectedly stopping during a session
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Fixed double-tap shortcuts triggering accidentally after clicks such as `⌘ + Click`
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Fixed recording and triggering navigation-key shortcuts, including `Home`, `End`, `Page Up`, and `Page Down`, without an unwanted `Fn` modifier
- **Quicklinks**: Fixed issues where Quicklink icons would not reliably update or display
- **Quicklinks**: Fixed a regression preventing from saving a Quicklink
- **Quicklinks**: Fixed flashing/jumping issues in search view when navigating entries
- **Root Search**: Fixed `Tab` and alias navigation to focus the first empty command argument
- **Root Search**: Fixed running a command with missing required arguments in compact mode to expand the window and focus the missing argument
- **Script Commands**: Fixed fallback commands not receiving the search query as their first argument
- **UI**: Ensured consistent window-blurred icon opacity between single/grouped buttons
- **Notes**: Fixed Copy Content from Search losing formatting when pasted into rich text editors
- **Notes**: Fixed line breaks being lost when pasting text
- **Notes**: Fixed pasted Markdown being formatted inside code blocks instead of remaining plain text
- **Notes**: Fixed newly inserted dividers reverting to Markdown when pressing `Backspace`. The first press now selects the divider, and the second deletes it

![image](https://misc-assets.raycast.com/releases/8180fca8af2a3dd485321a4b2ffbcf08b4351060083a24309b72382035035638.png)

我们对内存占用和性能进行了多项改进。Raycast 主进程的内存占用现已降低约 50%；每个插件进程启动时的内存占用降低约 30%，启动时的 CPU 占用也有所减少，这有助于改善菜单栏命令、后台刷新和 AI 工具的表现。我们还修复了一个会随 Raycast 运行时间增长而加剧的内存泄漏问题。更多详情见下文，后续更新还将继续优化。

## 🤖 自动模型

我们重新设计了自动模型，现在你可以选择它如何为你挑选模型。共有三种偏好：轻量、均衡和旗舰。默认的“均衡”模式比“旗舰”模式少消耗约 70% 的积分，让积分更耐用。“轻量”模式的响应耗时比“旗舰”模式缩短约 70%，适合快速问答。“旗舰”模式使用能力最强的模型处理复杂任务，需要 Pro+ 或 Max 订阅。

## ✨ 新增功能

- **AI**：可在 AI 聊天的 `/usage` 和设置中查看 Claude、ChatGPT 订阅用量。
- **AI**：新增显示 AI 积分、Claude 和 ChatGPT 用量的命令。
- **剪贴板历史**：为 TIFF 图像新增“粘贴为 PNG”操作。
- **主搜索**：更多设置可直接出现在搜索结果中，包括辅助功能设置和键盘快捷键。
- **界面**：新增自动颜色对比度调整，提高界面的可读性。

## 💎 改进

- **AI 聊天**：仅在聊天首次需要时加载 Mermaid 图表功能，减少内存占用。
- **AI 权限**：“始终允许”的批准范围扩展至相似命令。

We made more memory and performance improvements. AI Chat, Notes and Settings now each run in their own process, so a busy chat or a heavy note no longer slows down Root Search, and closing them frees up their memory. The launcher can use up to 35% less memory while idle. File Search uses up to 80% less memory at peak and up to 95% less while searching, searches are up to 30% faster, and background indexing uses much less CPU. More details are below.


## 💬 Send Context to AI


Two new commands let you show AI exactly what you're looking at. **Send Element to AI** lets you hover over anything on your screen, like a paragraph, an image or a button, and click to send it to AI Chat. To share a whole window instead, use **Send Window to AI**.


**Tip:** Assign a hotkey like `⌘ + ⇧ + 0` to Send Element to AI to grab context even faster.


## ✨ New

- **Custom AI Providers**: You can now give custom provider models Raycast's Web Search, Read Page, Search Images and Chart tools. [Turn them on](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/custom-providers#tools) with a `tools` block in `providers.yaml`, and choose whether each one runs on Raycast, your company gateway, or a vendor you have a key for (Tavily, Exa, Firecrawl, Brave, Perplexity or Jina)
- **Script Commands**: Added controls to enable or disable background refresh for individual scripts

## 💎 Improvements

- **AI**: Made AI requests smaller, so local models reply to a simple message much faster than before and simple requests use fewer credits, without sacrificing response quality. Initial context is now 15% smaller for normal queries, and 40% smaller with automatic extension and skill discovery turned off
- **AI:** Improved Quick Fix performance
- **AI Skills**: Improved error details to help AI recover when a skill cannot be loaded
- **AI Chat**: Included archived chats in sidebar search results
- **AI Chat**: The extensions list in chat settings now shows every extension whose tools the chat uses, including Terminal, Finder and Automations
- **AI Commands**: AI Commands and automations no longer stop to show a question form. They now include any question in their reply instead
- **AI Commands**: When **Replace Selection** can't paste the response, the response is kept on your clipboard and in Clipboard History, and a warning tells you it was copied. This also applies to **Translator**
- **Dictation:** We now show a clearer status when wrapping up sessions and confirm with a success HUD when finishing a session
- **Dictation:** We improved post-processing to be faster and more reliable
- **Clipboard History**: Added an option to save Universal Clipboard items from your iPhone or iPad as soon as they arrive. Find it under Clipboard History settings
- **Extensions**: Added support for pasting files copied from Finder or File Explorer directly into file pickers
- **File Search**: Improved CPU and memory utilization. It now uses up to 80% less memory at peak and up to 95% less while searching. Searches are also up to 30% faster, depending on the search terms and number of documents
- **File Search**: Common development environment caches (e.g. `.cargo/global-cache`, `.venv`) are now excluded from indexing
- **File Search:** Added image dimensions to the details panel
- **Memory & Performance:** AI Chat, Notes and Settings now each run in their own process, separate from the launcher. A busy AI Chat or a heavy note no longer slows down Root Search, closed windows free their memory after a cooldown period so Raycast uses less while idle, and it's easier to see which part of Raycast is using memory or CPU
- **Navigation**: Added support for `Page Up` and `Page Down` in lists and grids
- **Root Search**: Improved ranking to favor complete words and exact title matches while preserving results learned from your previous searches
- **Root Search**: Prioritized applications when results are otherwise equally relevant
- **Settings:** AI Model provider sections in the Manage Models settings page now persist their collapsed state
- **Settings**: Opening a setting or command from elsewhere in Raycast now reliably scrolls to it and highlights it, including when you switch settings pages or select the same item again
- **Startup**: Raycast now waits for the keychain to become available instead of showing "Failed to start". If it waits more than 10 seconds, it tells you what it's waiting for

## 🐞 Fixes

- **Action Panel**: Fixed the action panel sometimes staying stuck open
- **AI Chat:** Fixed Quick Look when viewing attachments displaying an icon mid-transition
- **AI Chat**: Long chat titles and the model and reasoning effort labels truncate in the header
- **AI Chat**: Long model names in the `/` menu truncates, and hovering a model now shows a preview of its details
- **AI Chat**: Fixed chats created before 2.3.0 reopening with no agent and the default model. They now restore their original agent, model and reasoning effort
- **AI Chat**: Fixed Reasoning Effort being hidden for agents whose model is set to Inherit
- **AI Chat**: Fixed `⌘ + Enter` and `⌥ + Enter` not working while the tool-approval input is focused
- **AI Chat**: Fixed chats that AI had archived, pinned or deleted not updating in the sidebar until Raycast was restarted
- **Auto Quit**: Fixed apps like Slack being quit during calls on macOS 27
- **Clipboard History**: Fixed clipboard capture getting stuck when an app stopped responding while its copied content was being read
- **Dictation**: Fixed an issue where dictation would continue when you locked your machine or put it to sleep
- **Dictionary**: Allowed text selection in the detail view
- **Extensions**: Fixed manually running a command re-enabling background refresh after it had been disabled
- **Extensions**: Allowed text selection in list detail panels
- **Feedback**: Allowed Escape to close the window, respecting the user preference
- **File Search**: Brought back the Raycast v1 shortcut `⌘ + I` for **Show Info in Finder**
- **File Search:** Content search using Spotlight should now be faster and return the intended results
- **Focus**: Fixed apps blocked by a Focus session reopening before you acknowledged that the session ended. They're now restored when you dismiss the completion prompt, even after a restart
- **Hotkeys**: Fixed text typed right after opening Raycast with a hotkey being swallowed for a few seconds and then lost
- **Hotkey Recorder**: Fixed flickering when deleting a hotkey with Backspace
- **Launcher**: Fixed the global hotkey reopening the last command instead of Root Search, and the window not closing or returning to root after a command was opened by hotkey during startup
- **Notes**: Improved performance when opening notes with deeply nested lists
- **Notes**: Made sure notes you create now keep working after future updates
- **Notes**: Fixed code blocks being dropped when AI created or edited a note
- **Notes**: Fixed note titles of AI created notes not updating after first line edit
- **MCP**: Fixed edits to running servers reverting to their previous configuration
- **Memory Usage:** Fixed various memory leaks that could contribute to RAM usage growing
- **Open Camera**: Fixed the camera preview closing when Raycast loses focus, for example while changing Video Effects in Control Center. It now stays on screen until you close it
- **Quick AI**: Fixed new chats using the default model from the model list instead of the **Quick AI** default model set in Settings
- **Quicklinks**: Preserved favicons when “Open With” is a browser
- **Root Search**: Localized application names should now correctly be searchable
- **Root Search**: Prevented Quicklink arguments retaining focus after execution
- **Settings**: Fixed the selection highlight being too faint for disabled commands
- **Settings**: Fixed a crash when changing the interface size while the main window was hidden
- **Settings**: Fixed command rows expanding and highlighting again after you'd already navigated to them
- **Updater:** Fixed an issue where querying the updater's Login Items status could freeze Raycast.

我们进一步优化了内存占用与性能。AI 对话、笔记和设置现在各自在独立进程中运行，繁忙的对话或复杂的笔记不再拖慢主搜索，关闭后也会释放内存。启动器空闲时的内存占用最多降低 35%。文件搜索的峰值内存占用最多降低 80%，搜索期间最多降低 95%，搜索速度最多提升 30%，后台索引的 CPU 占用也显著减少。更多详情见下文。

## 💬 向 AI 发送上下文

两个新命令让你可以将正在查看的内容直接交给 AI。**将元素发送到 AI**：将指针移到屏幕上的段落、图片或按钮等元素上，点击即可发送到 AI 对话。若要分享整个窗口，请使用**将窗口发送到 AI**。

**提示：**为“将元素发送到 AI”设置快捷键，例如 `⌘ + ⇧ + 0`，便能更快地获取上下文。

## ✨ 新功能

- **自定义 AI 提供商**：现在可为自定义提供商的模型启用 Raycast 的网页搜索、读取网页、搜索图片和图表工具。在 `providers.yaml` 中添加 `tools` 配置块即可[启用这些工具](https://manual.raycast.com/ai/custom-providers#tools)，并可为每个工具选择使用 Raycast、公司网关，或你拥有密钥的服务商（Tavily、Exa、Firecrawl、Brave、Perplexity 或 Jina）。
- **脚本命令**：新增单独启用或停用各脚本后台刷新的控制选项。

## 💎 改进

- **AI**：缩小了 AI 请求，在保持回复质量的同时，让本地模型更快地回复简单消息，并减少简单请求消耗的额度。常规查询的初始上下文缩小了 15%；关闭自动发现扩展和技能后，缩小了 40%。
- **AI**：提升了快速修复的性能。
- **AI 技能**：完善了错误详情，帮助 AI 在无法加载技能时恢复。
- **AI 对话**：侧边栏搜索结果现在包含已归档的对话。
- **AI 对话**：对话设置中的扩展列表现在会显示对话所用工具对应的全部扩展，包括 Terminal、Finder 和自动化。
- **AI 命令**：AI 命令和自动化不再暂停并显示提问表单，需要询问的问题会直接包含在回复中。
- **AI 命令**：当**替换所选内容**无法粘贴回复时，回复会保留在剪贴板和剪贴板历史中，并提示已复制。此改进同样适用于**翻译器**。
- **听写**：结束会话时的状态提示更清晰，完成后会显示成功提示。
- **听写**：后处理速度更快，也更可靠。
- **剪贴板历史**：新增选项，可在收到 iPhone 或 iPad 的通用剪贴板内容后立即保存，可在剪贴板历史设置中开启。
- **扩展**：支持将从 Finder 或文件资源管理器复制的文件直接粘贴到文件选择器中。

This update is about speed. File Search returns results up to 6× faster and handles typos much better, Root Search and other lists scroll smoother than ever, and extensions install and update about 4× faster on average. Raycast also starts with about 20% less memory.


## ✨ New

- **AI Skills**: Browse installed extension skills in AI settings
- **Calendar**: Added support for joining Gong meetings
- **Emoji & Symbols**: Added Greek letters
- **Notes**: Cmd+click on a parent todo now toggles all nested todos

## 💎 Improvements

- **AI Chat**: Made mention labels clearer by distinguishing skills and MCP tools
- **AI Chat**: Reduced the data sent at the start of a chat by loading extension tools more selectively
- **AI Chat**: Added the New Project keyboard shortcut to button tooltips and made project creation action names consistent
- **AI Chat**: Clarified when you’ve reached the weekly Claude Fable usage limit
- **AI Chat**: Images you attach when using local models now stay on your device when Cloud Sync or AI Chat History sync is turned off
- **AI Chat**: Added a primary action setting to Send Window and Send Element to AI
- **Clipboard History**: Improved image & file icons
- **Custom Providers**: Numeric provider API keys are now kept exactly as written, and authentication failures are explained better when they occur
- **Dictation:** Settings are now organised better, making it easier to find exactly what you’re looking for
- **Extensions**: Installs and updates are about 4× faster on average, and up to 30× faster
- **File Search**: Results show up to 6× faster, slow searches are gone, typos are handled much better, and indexing your files is faster and uses less CPU
- **Lighter at startup**: Raycast uses about 20% less memory at launch and starts faster
- **Proxy**: Raycast now honors HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY for all its traffic.
- **Smoother scrolling**: Root Search and other lists scroll up to 2× faster
- **Updater:** Avoid automatic installation while Dictation or AIAgents are active in the background
- **Updater:** Detect an update installed from another user account on the same Mac

## 🐞 Fixes

- **AI Chat**: Fixed the window freezing during streaming of very long lists
- **AI Chat**: Fixed pasting into the composer not working when it isn’t focused
- **AI Chat**: Fixed new chats sending the wrong model when the saved model is unavailable
- **AI Chat**: Fixed image generation being unavailable with Ollama and extension models
- **AI Chat**: Fixed Claude subscription models compacting too early
- **AI Chat**: Fixed missing skill names when restoring chat history
- **AI Chat**: Fixed sidebar actions not responding while peeking at the sidebar
- **AI Chat**: Fixed archived chats also appearing in their project’s sidebar section
- **AI Chat**: Removed a misplaced loading indicator from the sidebar
- **AI Chat**: Fixed pressing Return not sending messages containing paths starting with `/`
- **AI Chat**: Show a subscription prompt when sending a message while signed out, instead of showing a send error
- **AI Chat**: Fixed `⌘ + ↑` and `⌘ + ↓` moving between messages before reaching the start or end of the composer text
- **AI Chat**: Agents you turn off in Settings no longer appear in the composer
- **Automations**: Fixed automations created in a project starting chats outside that project, and added project destinations to the automation settings
- **Claude**: Fixed subscription status remaining outdated after signing in and valid subscription accounts being incorrectly rejected
- **Extensions**: Fixed unnecessary scroll jumps while navigating lists and grids
- **Extensions**: Fixed ghost hotkeys for removed extension commands
- **File Search**: Fixed the “Indexing Files…” row sometimes spinning forever after launch
- **File Index**: Fixed changes made while Raycast was closed sometimes not being picked up on launch
- **File Index**: Fixed deleted or excluded files sometimes still showing up in results after a reboot
- **Quick AI**: Fixed an issue where the action bar would sometimes appear too high in authentication views
- **Root Search**: Fixed an issue affecting compact mode users where alias would sometimes not activate after pressing space
- **Script Commands**: Fixed optional argument prompts being skipped when launching from a hotkey
- **Script Commands**: Fixed inline scripts showing stale output after an error
- **Settings**: Fixed signed-in accounts without a display name incorrectly showing “Not Signed In”
- **Translator**: Fixed an issue where swapping language when the translation is loading would clear the input
- **UI**: Fixed an issue in the toast action panel where too much space was left below the description when no actions are present
- **Window Management**: Ignored hotkeys for missing layouts and custom commands
- **Menu Bar:** Items that hide themselves stay hidden after a restart.
- **Calendar**: Fixed the menu bar item disappearing when an event title was cut off mid-emoji.
- **App Relocation**: Fixed a blurry app icon in relocation alerts
- **Billing**: Fixed a "Subtotal" typo on the billing interval update page
- **Capture Window**: Fixed custom wallpaper accepting non-image files
- **Clipboard History**: Fixed Paste Sequentially repeating multi-category clipboard entries
- **General**: Fixed the missing Raycast version in database error alerts
- **Hyper Key**: Fixed the Secure Input HUD not pointing to the setting that fixes it
- **Menu Bar**: Fixed jumping menu bar extra titles by using monospaced digits
- **Open Camera**: Fixed Open Camera popping back to root while the preview is visible
- **Quick AI**: Fixed the missing Regenerate with Model action
- **Quicklinks**: Fixed "Invalid URL" being shown when {selection} could not be resolved
- **Snippets:** Fixed snippets not being expanded in Save File dialogs
- **Updater:** Raycast now relaunches itself if an update or restart fails after the app was already closed
- **Window Management:** Fixed "Switch to Previous/Next Space" without animation flickering or not working in macOS 27

本次更新着重提升速度。文件搜索返回结果的速度最高提升至原来的 6 倍，对拼写错误的处理也明显改善；主搜索和其他列表滚动更加流畅；扩展安装和更新的速度平均提升至原来的约 4 倍。此外，Raycast 启动时的内存占用降低了约 20%。

## ✨ 新功能

- **AI 技能**：可在 AI 设置中浏览已安装扩展提供的技能。
- **日历**：新增加入 Gong 会议的支持。
- **表情与符号**：新增希腊字母。
- **笔记**：按住 Command 点击父级待办事项，现在会同时切换所有嵌套待办事项的完成状态。

## 💎 改进

- **AI 对话**：区分技能与 MCP 工具，使提及标签更加清晰。
- **AI 对话**：更有选择地加载扩展工具，减少开始对话时发送的数据。
- **AI 对话**：在按钮提示中显示“新建项目”的快捷键，并统一创建项目相关操作的名称。
- **AI 对话**：更清晰地提示已达到 Claude Fable 每周用量上限。
- **AI 对话**：使用本地模型时，如果关闭了云同步或 AI 对话历史同步，附加的图片现在只会保留在设备上。
- **AI 对话**：为“将窗口发送到 AI”和“将元素发送到 AI”新增主要操作设置。
- **剪贴板历史**：改进图片和文件图标。
- **自定义提供商**：数字形式的提供商 API 密钥现在会按原样保留，并在身份验证失败时提供更清晰的说明。
- **听写**：重新整理设置，让所需选项更容易找到。
- **扩展**：安装和更新速度平均提升至原来的约 4 倍，最高可达 30 倍。
- **文件搜索**：结果显示速度最高提升至原来的 6 倍，解决搜索缓慢的问题，更好地处理拼写错误，并提高索引速度、降低 CPU 占用。
- **启动更轻快**：Raycast 启动时的内存占用降低约 20%，启动速度也更快。
- **代理**：Raycast 的所有网络流量现在均遵循 HTTP_PROXY、HTTPS_PROXY 和 NO_PROXY 设置。
- **滚动更流畅**：主搜索和其他列表的滚动速度最高提升至原来的 2 倍。
- **更新程序**：听写或 AI 智能体在后台活动时，避免自动安装更新。
- **更新程序**：可检测同一台 Mac 上其他用户账户安装的更新。
